name: HEY
description: HEY is a paid email and calendar provider from 37signals with the Imbox, Feed, Paper Trail, Screener, Collections, contacts, calendar, and team-domain features.
agentUseSummary: HEY cannot currently be connected because it explicitly does not support third-party email clients, IMAP, or POP and publishes no external HEY developer API, delegated OAuth registration, scopes, token lifecycle, webhooks, MCP server, or stable schemas. SMTP send-as, forwarding, and manual export are product or portability features rather than mailbox authorization for Relay.

blocked.label: Connect a HEY account
blocked.description: HEY publishes no external application registration and delegated account authorization lifecycle for third-party mailbox access.

blocked.label: Use standard mail protocols
blocked.description: HEY explicitly states that third-party email applications do not work and that it does not support IMAP or POP.

blocked.label: Relabel portability as an API
blocked.description: SMTP send-as, forwarding, MBOX export, and vCard export do not authorize an external client to read or act on a live HEY mailbox.

blocked.label: Alias another 37signals product
blocked.description: Basecamp and other 37signals APIs are separate products and cannot be used as HEY email/calendar semantics.

blocked.label: Access HEY data
blocked.description: Accounts, messages, threads, Imbox, Feed, Paper Trail, Screener, Collections, contacts, calendar, journal, domains, exports, and every read or write are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled without an official external HEY provider contract.

runtimeSupport.description: HEY has no external provider contract that Relay can mount as OpenClaw tools.
HEY has no external provider contract that Relay can mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: HEY rejects third-party mail clients and standard mailbox protocols and provides no public external API, delegated OAuth, scopes, token lifecycle, webhooks, MCP, or provider schemas.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request HEY credentials or show Connect. Reconsider only if 37signals publishes or supplies a current multi-tenant external HEY API or MCP contract with delegated authorization and HEY-native schemas.

evidence.supports: HEY states that it is an email provider, third-party email apps do not work with it, and IMAP/POP are not supported.
HEY documents itself as a replacement email provider rather than a client of Gmail, Outlook, Apple, or other mailbox providers.
HEY permits forwarding but explicitly does not provide IMAP or POP account access.
HEY offers paid personal and domain email/calendar services but no external developer authorization product.
